title: Cypraea-Radiogram'01.jpg
caption: A radiographic (X-ray) image of a group of Cypraea shells: first, a radiogram of the shells was taken; then, in a photographic darkroom, a contact print of the radiogram was obtained; finally, the contact print was scanned and manipulated in computer.
